sources.title: Kokoro TTS: Advanced AI Text-to-Speech Model with 82M parameters
sources.snippet: Kokoro TTS is a cutting-edge text-to-speech model with just 82 million parameters, delivering high-quality, natural-sounding speech. Despite its compact size, it outperforms many larger models in both efficiency and performance.
